definitions.context: ROI intersect Valid minus 5 native-pixel square dilation of union(all annotated GT polygons, historical request edit support)
definitions.distance: 1-cosine of paired L2-normalized pooled P3-64 and original learned projection-128
definitions.domain_probe: Leave-one-independent-source-group-out balanced nearest normalized-centroid; two domain examples per group; ties receive 0.5; no fitted model or optimizer
definitions.edit_support: Same-frame historical RGBA request mask alpha==0; request support does not prove edits were confined there
definitions.input: Original and historical aligned repair in the same full 640 letterbox; RGB /255; no random augmentation
definitions.interpretation: All are descriptive artifact/representation PROXIES, not pure style causal effects, semantic restoration, normal GT, or G1 PASS thresholds
definitions.model: Frozen J1 seed42 epoch100 FP32 master including its original projection; eval/inference_mode, no optimizer
definitions.pixels: Same valid proxy context: RGB absolute error /255, signed mean RGB change, grayscale Laplacian variance ratio, RGB perimeter contrast change
definitions.pooling: Nearest-neighbor native /4 binary raster, average /2 fractional P3 weights, same project_regions as Exp15
definitions.population: 36 previously selected historical D0 pilot cases; 36 independent frozen source groups; not a random sample
definitions.target: Historical target Polygon intersected with Valid, shared by both domains

limitations: Historical hand-selected population, no population-level estimate.
Content/registration and generation effects confound domain separation; this is not pure style identification.
Context excludes all annotated GT and requested edit support but may contain unannotated defects or edits outside request support.
No thresholds, filtering, semantic approvals, or trusted Pairs are produced.
